scenario_A_strong_GO.trigger: Bundang has Graves' n>50 AND PTC+HT n>30 with RNA-seq/SNP
deliverables: Pan-Asian HLA meta (Han + K2 + Lee + Bundang)
must_have: Bundang HLA imputation (cookHLA on SNP) or arcasHLA on RNA-seq

scenario_B_moderate_GO.trigger: Bundang has PTC cohort (any n) but NO Graves'/HT
deliverables: 8-gene panel external validation on Bundang PTC
drop: Graves' arm — defer to Phase 2 paper

scenario_C_method_paper.trigger: Bundang non-responsive 6+ weeks OR all access denied
deliverables: DIAL audit framework + agent forensic case study (8-gene Task B)

scenario_D_minimum_viable.trigger: Manuscript freeze required by date (paper conflict, ARIA pull-back, etc.)
deliverables: Minimal: 8-gene panel + DM1/DM2 + K2 validation only
